absolute participle from the root jñā
optative third singular active from the root sādh

items.question: What should one accomplish after knowing the five-flower handful?
items.inference: One should accomplish the rites after knowing the five-flower handful
uncertainties: The exact ritual context of the five-flower handful is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: O goddess, having known the five-flower handful, one should accomplish the rites.
